info.title: Sphynx API
info.description: Run agent evals and manage prompts. Every endpoint takes a JSON body over POST and authenticates with a bearer API key.

WhoamiCredential.description: The credential that authenticated the call. For an API key, its name and its first characters, never the secret.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Check the credential a client is using before it starts work.

tags.name: Environment
tags.description: The keys and subscriptions eval runs use. Known names such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY run the matching harness, judge or sandbox; other names reach a run when its profile names them.

tags.name: Batches
tags.description: Runs started together, such as every case of a suite on every variant.

tags.name: Suites
tags.description: A prompt and workspace shared by many cases. List its cases with `evals.cases.list` and its `suite` filter.

tags.name: Cases
tags.description: One eval each, belonging to a suite, run on one or more variants.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: One case run on one variant, with its trials.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: The models a variant can name.

tags.name: Prompts
tags.description: Read and write prompts. Content is versioned, so writes append rather than overwrite, and channels decide which version callers receive.
